drums.description: Drum solo in a progressive rock and fusion style, The performance features a full acoustic drum kit including a crisp, high-tuned snare, a punchy kick drum, multiple rack and floor toms, hi-hats, a ride cymbal, and several crash cymbals, The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time, The piece is characterized by complex linear patterns, rapid 16th-note fills across the toms, and syncopated ghost notes on the snare, It utilizes dynamic shifts from ghost-note grooves to heavy accented crashes, The solo incorporates polyrhythmic elements and double-kick pedal flurries, The recording has a natural room reverb with a clear, modern production aesthetic Publish

bass.description: Funk-rock fusion featuring a prominent, syncopated electric bass line with heavy slap and pop techniques, The bass plays a repetitive, percussive riff in E minor at 105 BPM, A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic scratches and muted 16th-note patterns, The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat openings, In the middle section, the bass transitions to a melodic, high-register solo with rapid-fire thumb slaps and finger-style runs, The track concludes with a return to the primary groove, layering the slap bass over a consistent kick drum pulse Publish
